**Concept used:**

Relative change in percentage = [(X₂ - X₁)/X₁] × 100

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

Increase in percentage in 2 years = [(334 - 268)/268] × 100

⇒ (66/268) × 100 

⇒ 0.2462 × 100 = 24.62% ~ 25%

**∴ The percentage increase in the total production of all types of two-wheelers is 25%.**
